questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til et engelsktalende land, hvor jeg havde mulighed for at blive bedre til engelsk. Derudover har jeg altid gerne ville til Californien, og derfor gav det god mening at søge University of California

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var ret nemt, fordi at KU var gode til at informere os om, hvad vi skulle have styr på inden afrejse. Derudover, fordi University of California er så stor en udvekslingsaftale, er der et stort netværk at trække på i form af Facebook grupper osv, hvor man kan stille spørgsmål.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var et orienteringsmøde da vi ankom

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Vi blev opkrævet 100 dollars i 'International fees', hvor det ikke blev oplyst hvad det dækkede over. Det er en generel ting, at de opkræver mange gebyrer, hvor det ikke er gennemskueligt, hvad de egentlig dækker over.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Jeg boede i International Lliving Center, som var der hvor udvekslingsstuderende primært boede. Det var lejligheder, hvilket betød at der var eget køkken osv som gjorde at det føltes mere hjemligt.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde eget køkken

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Hvis du skal til USA, skal du være opmærksom på at de tillader ESA's på campus. ESA står for 'Emotional support animal', og jeg endte med at dele værelse med en pige, som havde en kat. Det fyldte meget, især fordi jeg ikke vidste det på forhånd. Katten var ikke renlig, og det var et meget lille værelse, hvilket gjorde at det i sidste ende skabte konflikt, hvilket ikke er det man gider bruge sit udvekslingsophold på.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man fik en dato for, hvornår man kunne tilmelde sig kurser, og så gik man ind og valgte de kurser, som man gerne ville have. Dette blev gjort gennem universitetets egen portal og var meget intuitivt.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man bliver spammet med mails fra studievejledere, som gerne vil hjælpe dig med at orientere dig og sikre at du har de rigtige forudsætninger for at kunne tilmelde dig faget.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de fag, jeg havde udset mig på forhånd.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Man laver selv sit eget skema, så det er nice at samle undervisningen på nogle enkelte dage. Jeg havde feks. fri både mandag og fredag.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Man skal ikke tage afsted hvis man gerne vil have faglige udfordringer. Min generelle opfattelse var, at niveauet er meget lavt.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde flere forelæsninger, hvilket adskiller sig en del fra hvad jeg er vant til.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Media and Social Movements, Introduction to American Politics, Feminist Theories, Reproductive Justice, Feminist Interventions, History from the Present

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Introduction to American Politics - det var nice at få et indblik i et valgsystem, som er utrolig komplekst og uigennemskueligt.

Food DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Jeg har brugt mange penge på leje af biler, da man er afhængig af at have en bil, hvis man skal på ture osv.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Alt var dyrere end hvad jeg havde regnet med

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Universitet havde et kæmpe gym som var gratis hvilket var virkelig nice. Der kunne man svømme, spille tennis, gå til yoga og meget mere

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Meld dig ind i backpacking-klubben! De laver fede billige vandreture

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tæt på Santa Cruz ligger Pinnacles National park, virkelig nice

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var okay nemt. Det største var at vænne sig til at infrastrukturen bare er lavet til biler.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Tag til de første arrangementer med de andre internationale. Det er nice i forhold til at møde andre udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Deres åbenhed, som jo er fed, men som man lige skal vænne sig til.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Nysgerrigheden over at lære om andre kulturer.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Forbered dig på at alt er dyrt, Campus er kæmpe stort, der er meget meget smukt og naturrigt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg sidder tilbage med en oplevelse af, at det er et universitet som primært går op i profit fremfor at fremme læring og bekymre sig om deres studerende.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At møde så mange forskellige mennesker og kulturer.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Min boligsituation

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
